scenes.say: The simplest strategy in the tournament beat the experts' clever ones. One rule: copy what they just did.
Robert Axelrod ran a tournament of repeated prisoner's dilemmas. Tit for Tat won.
scenes.note: Source: Axelrod (1984), The Evolution of Cooperation

scenes.say: Code re-runs a small version: {n_strats} strategies, every pair, {rounds} rounds.
Tit for Tat finishes number {tft_rank} with {tft_score} points. Always Defect gets {defect_score}.
The top two both have one thing in common: they're never the first to betray.
Be nice first. Hit back immediately. Forgive immediately. Simple, and hard to exploit.

takeaway: Be nice first. Hit back immediately. Forgive immediately. Simple, and hard to exploit.
